title: Topology-Prior-Guided Regional Latent Dynamics for Transient Structural Response Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.30293v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Predicting the transient nonlinear responses of complex engineering structures remains challenging due to large finite element meshes, heterogeneous structural components, and history-dependent mechanical behavior. This study proposes a topology-prior-guided regional latent dynamics (TPLD) surrogate model that combines physically structured regional representations with dynamics-aware latent learning for full-field time-history prediction. Based on mesh topology and engineering priors, structural responses are encoded into spatially coupled regional latent variables through region-aware feature extraction and topology-constrained interactions. An auxiliary one-step prediction task enhances latent-space dynamical predictability by introducing state-transition supervision. translated_title: 拓扑先验引导的区域潜变量动力学方法用于瞬态结构响应预测
translated_abstract: 由于大型有限元网格、异质结构组件以及历史依赖的力学行为，预测复杂工程结构的瞬态非线性响应仍然具有挑战性。本研究提出了一种拓扑先验引导的区域潜变量动力学（TPLD）代理模型，该模型将物理结构化的区域表示与动力学感知的潜空间学习相结合，用于全场时程预测。基于网格拓扑和工程先验，通过区域感知特征提取和拓扑约束交互，结构响应被编码为空间耦合的区域潜变量。辅助单步预测任务通过引入状态转移监督来增强潜空间的动力学可预测性。随后，一个载荷条件化的时空Mamba模型通过整合时间因果扫描和双向空间扫描来预测区域潜变量轨迹……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种拓扑先验引导的区域潜变量动力学（TPLD）代理模型，利用网格拓扑先验、状态转移监督和载荷条件化时空Mamba架构，实现对复杂工程结构瞬态非线性响应的高效全场时程预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a topology-prior-guided regional latent dynamics (TPLD) surrogate model that leverages mesh topology priors, state-transition supervision, and a load-conditioned spatiotemporal Mamba architecture for efficient full-field prediction of transient nonlinear structural responses.
